activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Nadia said that she would email the receipt the next day.
cards.explanation: Would y the next day adapt correctamente will y tomorrow.

cards.statement: The receptionist said that the office are closed for repairs.
cards.explanation: Office es singular: debe ser was closed en el backshift o is closed si se conserva el presente.

cards.statement: The engineer explained that the device was working normally.
cards.explanation: Was working es el retroceso correcto de is working.

cards.statement: The manager told us that she could join the call remotely.
cards.explanation: Could es la forma indirecta natural de can en este contexto pasado.

cards.statement: The guide said that the tickets would be collected at the desk.
cards.explanation: Would be collected conserva la perspectiva futura del anuncio pasado.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 6 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: The lecturer said that water boils at 100°C.
cards.explanation: El presente se mantiene correctamente para una verdad científica.

cards.statement: The director said that the film would released in October.
cards.explanation: La pasiva futura necesita would be released.

cards.statement: The researcher explained that the results was significant.
cards.explanation: Results es plural; la forma correcta es the results were significant.

cards.statement: The pilot said that the plane had been land before the storm.
cards.explanation: La pasiva o el perfecto necesitan un participio: had landed o had been landed según el significado.

cards.statement: The nurse said me that I should avoid coffee.
cards.explanation: Say no lleva objeto personal de esa forma: the nurse told me that...

cards.statement: The doctor said that I must remain under observation.
cards.explanation: Must puede mantenerse cuando la obligación sigue vigente.

cards.statement: The scientist said that the sample did not contained mercury.
cards.explanation: Después de did not usamos la forma base contain, no contained.

cards.statement: The report stated that exports had fallen by twelve per cent.
cards.explanation: Had fallen sitúa el descenso antes del informe.

cards.statement: The teacher said that the Earth moves around the Sun.
cards.explanation: Moves es adecuado porque el hecho sigue siendo verdadero.

cards.statement: The archivist said that the reading room was closed after lunch.
cards.explanation: Was closed es el backshift natural de is closed.

cards.statement: Mira said that she would arrived the next day.
cards.explanation: Después de would usamos el infinitivo arrive, no el participio arrived.

cards.statement: The pilots told us that they had landed before the fog arrived.
cards.explanation: Had landed sitúa el aterrizaje antes del aviso a los oyentes.

cards.statement: The historian said that the bridge had been built in 1890.
cards.explanation: Had been built expresa una construcción anterior al comentario histórico.
